title: Set a reply header
summary: Fiber: Set a reply header. Inspect the response with curl -i.
introduction: Set adds a response header. Open GET /note and inspect Cache-Control.
learningObjectives: Set a reply header with Fiber

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Set a reply header
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/note", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { c.Set("Cache-Control", "no-store"); return c.SendString("Practice note") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: Set adds Cache-Control before SendString writes the response.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Set headers before sending the body.
